equity_bridge.item: Suntory consideration for Daiichi Sankyo Healthcare, remaining staged tranches at PV
equity_bridge.note: ~246.5bn total agreed April 2026, staged to 2029; ~74bn received in H1 FY2027 (already in cash). Remaining ~172bn discounted ~2 years at 7% = ~150bn. Base growth in years 1-3 is trimmed ~1pp for the OTC revenue leaving the perimeter

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: Guidance-anchored blend: FY2027 guidance +10.2% (H1 ran +19.7%), the FY2026-2030 plan's >3.0tn revenue by repo FY2031 (~7.5% CAGR from FY2026), decelerating thereafter. Equity CAGR (5.2-5.8%) rejected as the base-growth anchor because 396bn of buybacks and 243bn of dividends over FY2025-FY2026 depress it.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3yr CAGR 5.2% diverges >30% from revenue 18.4% and EPS 38.5%: the gap is capital returned (buybacks + dividends ~640bn in two years) plus the FY2026 earnings dip from temporary CMO/Odawara charges, not weak compounding.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series (reported FCF - SBC - interest income, JPY bn): FY2021 114.8, FY2022 59.9, FY2023 17.0, FY2024 449.6 (Merck 4bn USD upfront received), FY2025 -161.6, FY2026 -96.4. CAGRs are undefined on a negative end-point and meaningless on this series: the upfronts land in one year's OCF and are recognised as revenue over the following decade, while the ADC inventory/receivable build and the taxation of upfronts on receipt have made the last two years cash-negative despite 280-296bn of net income. Revenue and EPS CAGRs are the growth evidence; SBC is 0.3% of revenue and does not distort them.

scenario_narratives.base: Daiichi Sankyo delivers roughly its FY2026-FY2030 plan: revenue ~3.2tn by repo FY2031 on ENHERTU label expansion (earlier lines, pan-tumor, early breast cancer) and DATROWAY's NSCLC/TNBC build, net of Lixiana loss of exclusivity, American Regent decline and Japan NHI price cuts. Adjusted EBITDA climbs from the guidance-implied ~18.5% to 25% as the CMO compensation charges roll off and Operational Excellence savings land, capped structurally by the 50% ex-Japan gross-profit share to AstraZeneca and ~21% R&D. Working-capital intensity (inventory 1.7x COGS) and the 33% cash-tax rate normalise gradually, so owner FCF margin rises from ~3% to ~12% over the decade. Growth fades to 2.5% by Y10 as ENHERTU's US exclusivity ends ~2031 and the next-wave ADCs replace only part of it.
scenario_narratives.bull: Multiple pipeline successes stack: ENHERTU reaches 1L/adjuvant across markets, DATROWAY wins TNBC 1L and the ivonescimab combinations, and two of HER3-DXd/I-DXd/R-DXd launch by FY2030, taking revenue above plan (3.5tn by FY2031) and sustaining high-single-digit growth into the 2030s. Margin reaches 29% on full Operational Excellence delivery and scale; working-capital drag halves as the inventory build stabilises; JPY stays weak. Terminal 20x, 2.5% growth.
scenario_narratives.bear: JPY strengthening removes the translation tailwind, Lixiana and American Regent erode as scheduled, ENHERTU growth stalls against ADC competition and US pricing policy, HER3-DXd and I-DXd fail to reach the US market, CMO compensation keeps recurring, and ENHERTU's exclusivity cliff from ~2031 turns revenue negative in Y7-Y10. Adjusted EBITDA stuck at 16-18%, cash tax elevated longer. Terminal 14x, 1% growth.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value the DXd ADC franchise as a cash-flow stream on the component build, charging every real cost once: the 50% AstraZeneca profit share and R&D inside the margin, CMO compensation as an operating cost rather than a one-off, leases as operating cost, in-licensing inside capex, working-capital build as a negative capture on growth, and the elevated cash-tax rate until the upfront-tax prepayment unwinds. Interest and dividend income are stripped and their source assets added back, net cash and the contracted Suntory proceeds are bridged. The horizon runs 10 years because the FCF margin is still ramping at year 5 and because ENHERTU's exclusivity cliff falls inside the decade and must be visible in the fade, not hidden in the terminal value.
key_risks_to_valuation: Product concentration: ENHERTU (~39% of revenue) and DATROWAY drive essentially all growth; a safety (ILD) or competitive setback moves every scenario
FX: reported JPY revenue is >60% USD/EUR; 10 yen on USD/JPY is roughly 5% of revenue
Working-capital and cash-tax normalisation is assumed, not demonstrated: two consecutive years of negative owner FCF on 280-296bn of net income
Pipeline binary events: HER3-DXd, I-DXd, R-DXd each already carry a regulatory setback; bull weight depends on them
ENHERTU exclusivity (~2031 US) and ADC biosimilar/competitor timing set the terminal value
Internal controls: FY2026 results required correction; CMO minimum-purchase obligations have produced 88bn + 80bn of charges in two years
Equity bridge judgments: 50% haircut on 216bn non-current financial assets and PV of the staged Suntory consideration are estimates, ~140 yen/share combined

inputs.sbc_source: FY2026 consolidated cash flow statement add-back 'Share-based payments' (4568.T_Quarterly_Q4-2026_Corrected.txt, the corrected FY tanshin); EquityAwardTaxes nil in every year. The line includes cash-settled share appreciation rights accruals, which is why it swung 21.8bn (FY2023) -> 2.9bn (FY2025) -> 7.0bn (FY2026); at 0.33% of revenue the treatment is immaterial either way.
inputs.share_count_basis: 1,862,893,329 issued less 40,827,459 own shares at 2026-09-30 (H1 FY2027 tanshin p.4) = 1,822.07m, plus 0.89m potential shares from subscription rights (FY2026 diluted EPS note) = 1,823.0m fully diluted. Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flows. Buybacks (246bn FY2025, 150bn FY2026) far exceed SBC, so the flat count is a conservative convention the company is more than funding.
inputs.fy_label_note: Repo labels fiscal years by END year: repo FY2026 = company 'FY2025' (year ended 31 March 2026); repo FY2027 = company 'FY2026' guidance year ending 31 March 2027.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-30T06:30:00Z (TSE regular close, first session after Q2 FY2026 results released 30 Oct 2026)
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in JPY, the currency of the flows: 10y JGB ~1.7% (Oct-2026) + beta 1.0 x Japan ERP 6.0% = 7.7% cost of equity; pre-tax cost of debt ~1.0% (0.7% after tax) on bonds/borrowings; weights ~91% equity / 9% debt at market (equity ~5.0tn vs 0.5tn debt) -> 7.1%, rounded to 7.0%. Same WACC in all three scenarios; pipeline, FX and LOE risk are carried in the scenario flows and weights, not stacked into the rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) leases as operating cost. IFRS 16 lease principal (18.1bn FY2026, 11.8bn H1 FY2027) plus lease interest (~1bn) is charged inside EBIT via lease_cost_pct_path at 0.9% of revenue; lease liabilities (inside 'other financial liabilities', ~51bn) are EXCLUDED from net debt; da_pct_path is D&A ex right-of-use depreciation (total D&A 3.65% of revenue less ~0.85% ROU) so the lease is charged once.
inputs.nci_treatment: Non-controlling interest was nil through FY2026 and ~1% of H1 FY2027 profit (153.1bn total vs 151.5bn attributable). Flows are modelled on the consolidated basis with no NCI bridge deduction; the ~1% leakage is inside the cash-tax path's noise. Revisit if NCI grows.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (SKILL.md routing row 2: operating company, non-US; adaptations file read for currency, leases, NCI, matching-asset rule). Daiichi Sankyo is a profitable, growing oncology pharma, so the standard owner-FCF route applies; no prior DCF exists (fresh build). FCF BASE: last_fcf = reported FCF (OCF 77,655 less PPE capex 128,365 less intangible acquisitions 20,637 = -71,347) less SBC 7,035 less interest income 18,009 = -96,391. The negative base is a working-capital and cash-tax artefact, not an earnings one: FY2026 inventories rose 172.7bn and receivables 104.6bn (ADC supply-chain build; inventory now 1.7x annual COGS), long-term advance payments to CMOs rose 25.5bn, and cash taxes of 128.5bn ran at 44% of PBT because Japan taxed the Merck/AZ upfronts on receipt (hence the 474bn deferred tax asset). The projection is built from components, so the base FCF is informational: year-1 owner FCF comes out around 65bn (2.8% of revenue) and matures toward ~12% as working-capital intensity and the cash-tax rate normalise. INTEREST INCOME stripped (net cash 180bn plus ~264bn other financial assets vs a negative FCF base); matching assets are added in equity_bridge. CAPEX uses PPE + intangible acquisitions: in-licensing/milestone intangibles are a recurring cost for a pharma with active in-licensing (14-72bn/yr over the last decade), and PPE capex (128bn FY2026, 6.0% of revenue) is the DXd ADC capacity build (Japan/US/EU plants) that the 5-year plan continues. EBITDA definition: adjusted EBITDA = operating profit + D&A + SBC, so the engine's SBC and lease deductions are not double-charged; FY2026 reported 15.8% was depressed by ~153bn of temporary charges (CMO compensation 88bn, Odawara cancellation), ex which it was ~23%; FY2027 guidance implies ~19% (core OP 360 incl. the 80bn CY2028 CMO provision + D&A ~85 + SBC 8 on 2,340bn). WORKING CAPITAL: net working capital (receivables 701 + inventories 797 - payables 612 = 886bn) is 42% of revenue, and deferred-revenue release (~30-60bn/yr of non-cash revenue from the 865bn contract liabilities) adds a further drag, so wc_capture_pct is NEGATIVE (-30% base): growth consumes cash. DS HEALTHCARE DIVESTITURE: the Japan OTC arm is being sold to Suntory for ~246.5bn in staged tranches to 2029 (assets held for sale 113bn at 30-Sep-2026; 74bn proceeds already received in H1 FY2027 and inside cash). The remaining consideration is added in the bridge at PV and the perimeter exit is reflected by trimming base growth ~1pp in years 1-3. No prior DCF: fresh build, no reconciliation block.

bear.narrative: JPY strengthens back toward 135-140 (guidance assumes 150; H1 ran 159), erasing the translation tailwind; Lixiana loses exclusivity in the EU and Japan on schedule and American Regent keeps shrinking; ENHERTU growth slows as TROP2/HER2 ADC competitors (Trodelvy, Pfizer/Seagen, Chinese entrants) and IRA/MFN price pressure bite, and US biologic exclusivity ends ~2031 with revenue declining from Y7. HER3-DXd and I-DXd, each already withdrawn once, do not reach the US market; CMO minimum-purchase compensation recurs every year; the 50% AZ profit share and ~21% R&D hold adjusted EBITDA at 16-18%. Cash taxes stay elevated longer. Terminal capped at 14x and 1% growth for a business past its lead product's cliff.

base.growth_rationale: Y1 11% is guidance +10.2% plus the H1 run-rate (+19.7%, +12% ex-FX) less ~1pp for the OTC perimeter exit; the H2 implied by guidance (+2%) assumes USD/JPY 150 vs 159 spot. Y2-Y5 track the 5-year plan to ~3.2tn by repo FY2031 (plan: >3.0tn): ENHERTU label expansions and DATROWAY offset Lixiana LOE (EU/Japan 2026-28), American Regent decline and NHI price cuts. Y6-Y10 decelerate toward 2.5% as ENHERTU approaches the end of US biologic exclusivity (~2031) and the next-wave ADCs (HER3-DXd, I-DXd, R-DXd) only partially replace it.
base.margin_rationale: Adjusted EBITDA (OP + D&A + SBC) 18.5% in Y1 sits between the reported-OP basis of guidance (320 + 85 + 8 = 17.6%) and the core basis (19.4%), carrying the 80bn CY2028 CMO provision as a real cost. Ramps to 25% by Y7: FY2025 peak was 21.4% and FY2026 ex-temporary charges ~23%; the plan's >200bn Operational Excellence savings and ADC scale lift it further, but the 50% ex-Japan gross-profit share paid to AstraZeneca and R&D at ~21% of revenue cap it well below big-pharma norms of 30-35%.
base.tax_rationale: Cash tax has run 31-44% of PBT (FY2024-26) because Japan taxed the AZ/Merck upfronts on receipt and ADC inventory profit is taxed at source before consolidation (DTA 474bn). Path starts at 33% and converges to 29% (Japan ~30.6% blended with US/EU) as the deferred revenue is recognised without further cash tax. The existing DTA's reversal is NOT credited in the bridge: conservative.
base.capex_rationale: 6.5% of revenue (PPE 6.0% + intangibles ~1% in FY2026; 10% in FY2025 with 72bn of in-licensing) through the capacity build, easing to 4.5% once the Japan/US/EU DXd plants are commissioned; D&A ex-ROU rises from 2.9% to 3.5% as those plants depreciate, leaving ~1pp of growth capex in perpetuity.
base.wc_rationale: -30% of the revenue CHANGE: FY2025-26 working-capital outflows were 90-144% of incremental revenue (inventory to 1.7x COGS, long-term CMO advances), which cannot persist, but NWC at 42% of revenue plus the non-cash deferred-revenue release mean growth will keep consuming cash. The drag shrinks automatically as growth decelerates.

bull.narrative: ENHERTU reaches 1L HER2+ and adjuvant/neoadjuvant early breast cancer plus pan-tumor across all major markets, DATROWAY wins TNBC 1L and the ivonescimab combinations, and at least two of HER3-DXd / I-DXd / R-DXd reach market by FY2030, so revenue exceeds the plan's 3.0tn (3.5tn by repo FY2031) and keeps compounding high-single-digit into the 2030s as the next-wave ADCs cover the ENHERTU exclusivity cliff. Operational Excellence delivers the full >200bn and the inventory build stabilises, so adjusted EBITDA reaches 29% and working-capital drag halves. JPY stays weak (USD/JPY ~150-160).

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 18x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 25% and bull cut from 35% to 25%. Bear: two of its legs are near-certain (Lixiana LOE 2026-28, American Regent decline) and two have already partly happened (HER3-DXd and I-DXd US withdrawals, recurring CMO compensation charges, an FY2026 results correction), and the group's economics rest on one product whose US exclusivity ends inside the horizon. Bull: needs several independent things to go right at once (two next-wave ADC launches, TNBC 1L, full cost-programme delivery, weak JPY persisting), so it cannot carry the default 35%. Base at 50%: H1 FY2027 (+19.7% revenue, +34% OP) shows the plan is on track, and ENHERTU's lead in HER2 is real.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
